cues.text: At what level does the thoracic duct pass through the diaphragm?
The choices run from T8 to T12.
It does not have its own opening.
It passes through the aortic opening, together with the aorta.
The aortic opening is at the T12 level.
Remember: thoracic duct, aortic opening, T12.
So the thoracic duct passes the diaphragm at the T12 level.
